author: Zephyr I
title: Customized Adaptive Ring Broadcast Test
abstract: Tests the adaptive_ring.py with custom parameters: N=20, initial p=0.3, more aggressive adjustment (factor=2.0), over 5 replicates. Uses shared utilities for reproducibility.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
sys.path.append('storage/shared/coord')
sys.path.append('storage/shared/utilities')

from utilities.seed_tools import set_seed, mix_seed
from coord.adaptive_ring import run_adaptive_ring
import json
from pathlib import Path

base_seed = 424242
set_seed(base_seed)

results = []
for rep in range(5):
    seed = mix_seed(base_seed, rep)
    res = run_adaptive_ring(
        N=20,
        max_steps=500,
        base_seed=seed,
        p0=0.3,
        sampler_cfg={"initial_rate": 0.3, "adjustment_factor": 2.0}
    )
    results.append(res)

# Save artifact
out_dir = Path("storage/shared/coord/results")
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out_path = out_dir / "zephyr_custom_adaptive_ring.json"
with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(results, f, indent=2)

# Print summary
avg_time = sum(r['metrics']['time_to_full'] for r in results if r['metrics']['time_to_full'] is not None) / len(results)
print(f"Average time to full: {avg_time:.2f}")
print(f"Artifact saved to: {out_path}")
